work.title: The Tragedy of Romeo and Juliet
work.author: William Shakespeare

lines.text: On Thursday, sir? The time is very short.
lines.plainText: On Thursday sir The time is very short

lines.text: My father Capulet will have it so;
lines.plainText: My father Capulet will have it so

lines.text: And I am nothing slow to slack his haste.
lines.plainText: And I am nothing slow to slack his haste

lines.text: You say you do not know the lady's mind.
lines.plainText: You say you do not know the lady's mind

lines.text: Uneven is the course; I like it not.
lines.plainText: Uneven is the course I like it not

lines.text: Immoderately she weeps for Tybalt's death,
lines.plainText: Immoderately she weeps for Tybalt's death

lines.text: And therefore have I little talk'd of love;
lines.plainText: And therefore have I little talk'd of love

lines.text: For Venus smiles not in a house of tears.
lines.plainText: For Venus smiles not in a house of tears

lines.text: Now, sir, her father counts it dangerous
lines.plainText: Now sir her father counts it dangerous

lines.text: That she do give her sorrow so much sway;
lines.plainText: That she do give her sorrow so much sway

lines.text: And in his wisdom, hastes our marriage,
lines.plainText: And in his wisdom hastes our marriage

lines.text: To stop the inundation of her tears,
lines.plainText: To stop the inundation of her tears

lines.text: Which, too much minded by herself alone,
lines.plainText: Which too much minded by herself alone

lines.text: May be put from her by society.
lines.plainText: May be put from her by society

lines.text: Now do you know the reason of this haste.
lines.plainText: Now do you know the reason of this haste

lines.text: [Aside.] I would I knew not why it should be slow'd.—
lines.plainText: Aside I would I knew not why it should be slow'd

lines.text: Look, sir, here comes the lady toward my cell.
lines.plainText: Look sir here comes the lady toward my cell

lines.text: Happily met, my lady and my wife!
lines.plainText: Happily met my lady and my wife

lines.text: That may be, sir, when I may be a wife.
lines.plainText: That may be sir when I may be a wife

lines.text: That may be, must be, love, on Thursday next.
lines.plainText: That may be must be love on Thursday next

lines.text: What must be shall be.
lines.plainText: What must be shall be

lines.text: That's a certain text.
lines.plainText: That's a certain text

lines.text: Come you to make confession to this father?
lines.plainText: Come you to make confession to this father

lines.text: To answer that, I should confess to you.
lines.plainText: To answer that I should confess to you

lines.text: Do not deny to him that you love me.
lines.plainText: Do not deny to him that you love me

lines.text: I will confess to you that I love him.
lines.plainText: I will confess to you that I love him

lines.text: So will ye, I am sure, that you love me.
lines.plainText: So will ye I am sure that you love me

lines.text: If I do so, it will be of more price,
lines.plainText: If I do so it will be of more price

lines.text: Being spoke behind your back than to your face.
lines.plainText: Being spoke behind your back than to your face

lines.text: Poor soul, thy face is much abus'd with tears.
lines.plainText: Poor soul thy face is much abus'd with tears

lines.text: The tears have got small victory by that;
lines.plainText: The tears have got small victory by that

lines.text: For it was bad enough before their spite.
lines.plainText: For it was bad enough before their spite

lines.text: Thou wrong'st it more than tears with that report.
lines.plainText: Thou wrong'st it more than tears with that report

lines.text: That is no slander, sir, which is a truth,
lines.plainText: That is no slander sir which is a truth

lines.text: And what I spake, I spake it to my face.
lines.plainText: And what I spake I spake it to my face

lines.text: Thy face is mine, and thou hast slander'd it.
lines.plainText: Thy face is mine and thou hast slander'd it

lines.text: It may be so, for it is not mine own.
lines.plainText: It may be so for it is not mine own

lines.text: Are you at leisure, holy father, now,
lines.plainText: Are you at leisure holy father now

lines.text: Or shall I come to you at evening mass?
lines.plainText: Or shall I come to you at evening mass

lines.text: My leisure serves me, pensive daughter, now.—
lines.plainText: My leisure serves me pensive daughter now

lines.text: My lord, we must entreat the time alone.
lines.plainText: My lord we must entreat the time alone

lines.text: God shield I should disturb devotion!—
lines.plainText: God shield I should disturb devotion

lines.text: Juliet, on Thursday early will I rouse ye,
lines.plainText: Juliet on Thursday early will I rouse ye

lines.text: Till then, adieu; and keep this holy kiss.
lines.plainText: Till then adieu and keep this holy kiss

lines.text: O shut the door, and when thou hast done so,
lines.plainText: O shut the door and when thou hast done so

lines.text: Come weep with me, past hope, past cure, past help!
lines.plainText: Come weep with me past hope past cure past help

lines.text: O Juliet, I already know thy grief;
lines.plainText: O Juliet I already know thy grief

lines.text: It strains me past the compass of my wits.
lines.plainText: It strains me past the compass of my wits

lines.text: I hear thou must, and nothing may prorogue it,
lines.plainText: I hear thou must and nothing may prorogue it

lines.text: On Thursday next be married to this County.
lines.plainText: On Thursday next be married to this County

lines.text: Tell me not, Friar, that thou hear'st of this,
lines.plainText: Tell me not Friar that thou hear'st of this

lines.text: Unless thou tell me how I may prevent it.
lines.plainText: Unless thou tell me how I may prevent it

lines.text: If in thy wisdom, thou canst give no help,
lines.plainText: If in thy wisdom thou canst give no help

lines.text: Do thou but call my resolution wise,
lines.plainText: Do thou but call my resolution wise

lines.text: And with this knife I'll help it presently.
lines.plainText: And with this knife I'll help it presently

lines.text: God join'd my heart and Romeo's, thou our hands;
lines.plainText: God join'd my heart and Romeo's thou our hands

lines.text: And ere this hand, by thee to Romeo's seal'd,
lines.plainText: And ere this hand by thee to Romeo's seal'd

lines.text: Shall be the label to another deed,
lines.plainText: Shall be the label to another deed

lines.text: Or my true heart with treacherous revolt
lines.plainText: Or my true heart with treacherous revolt

lines.text: Turn to another, this shall slay them both.
lines.plainText: Turn to another this shall slay them both

lines.text: Therefore, out of thy long-experienc'd time,
lines.plainText: Therefore out of thy longexperienc'd time

lines.text: Give me some present counsel, or behold
lines.plainText: Give me some present counsel or behold

lines.text: 'Twixt my extremes and me this bloody knife
lines.plainText: 'Twixt my extremes and me this bloody knife

lines.text: Shall play the empire, arbitrating that
lines.plainText: Shall play the empire arbitrating that

lines.text: Which the commission of thy years and art
lines.plainText: Which the commission of thy years and art

lines.text: Could to no issue of true honour bring.
lines.plainText: Could to no issue of true honour bring

lines.text: Be not so long to speak. I long to die,
lines.plainText: Be not so long to speak I long to die

lines.text: If what thou speak'st speak not of remedy.
lines.plainText: If what thou speak'st speak not of remedy

lines.text: Hold, daughter. I do spy a kind of hope,
lines.plainText: Hold daughter I do spy a kind of hope

lines.text: Which craves as desperate an execution
lines.plainText: Which craves as desperate an execution

lines.text: As that is desperate which we would prevent.
lines.plainText: As that is desperate which we would prevent

lines.text: If, rather than to marry County Paris
lines.plainText: If rather than to marry County Paris

lines.text: Thou hast the strength of will to slay thyself,
lines.plainText: Thou hast the strength of will to slay thyself

lines.text: Then is it likely thou wilt undertake
lines.plainText: Then is it likely thou wilt undertake

lines.text: A thing like death to chide away this shame,
lines.plainText: A thing like death to chide away this shame

lines.text: That cop'st with death himself to scape from it.
lines.plainText: That cop'st with death himself to scape from it

lines.text: And if thou dar'st, I'll give thee remedy.
lines.plainText: And if thou dar'st I'll give thee remedy

lines.text: O, bid me leap, rather than marry Paris,
lines.plainText: O bid me leap rather than marry Paris

lines.text: From off the battlements of yonder tower,
lines.plainText: From off the battlements of yonder tower

lines.text: Or walk in thievish ways, or bid me lurk
lines.plainText: Or walk in thievish ways or bid me lurk

lines.text: Where serpents are. Chain me with roaring bears;
lines.plainText: Where serpents are Chain me with roaring bears

lines.text: Or hide me nightly in a charnel-house,
lines.plainText: Or hide me nightly in a charnelhouse

lines.text: O'er-cover'd quite with dead men's rattling bones,
lines.plainText: O'ercover'd quite with dead men's rattling bones

lines.text: With reeky shanks and yellow chapless skulls.
lines.plainText: With reeky shanks and yellow chapless skulls

lines.text: Or bid me go into a new-made grave,
lines.plainText: Or bid me go into a newmade grave

lines.text: And hide me with a dead man in his shroud;
lines.plainText: And hide me with a dead man in his shroud

lines.text: Things that, to hear them told, have made me tremble,
lines.plainText: Things that to hear them told have made me tremble

lines.text: And I will do it without fear or doubt,
lines.plainText: And I will do it without fear or doubt

lines.text: To live an unstain'd wife to my sweet love.
lines.plainText: To live an unstain'd wife to my sweet love

lines.text: Hold then. Go home, be merry, give consent
lines.plainText: Hold then Go home be merry give consent

lines.text: To marry Paris. Wednesday is tomorrow;
lines.plainText: To marry Paris Wednesday is tomorrow

lines.text: Tomorrow night look that thou lie alone,
lines.plainText: Tomorrow night look that thou lie alone

lines.text: Let not thy Nurse lie with thee in thy chamber.
lines.plainText: Let not thy Nurse lie with thee in thy chamber

lines.text: Take thou this vial, being then in bed,
lines.plainText: Take thou this vial being then in bed

lines.text: And this distilled liquor drink thou off,
lines.plainText: And this distilled liquor drink thou off

lines.text: When presently through all thy veins shall run
lines.plainText: When presently through all thy veins shall run

lines.text: A cold and drowsy humour; for no pulse
lines.plainText: A cold and drowsy humour for no pulse

lines.text: Shall keep his native progress, but surcease.
lines.plainText: Shall keep his native progress but surcease

lines.text: No warmth, no breath shall testify thou livest,
lines.plainText: No warmth no breath shall testify thou livest

lines.text: The roses in thy lips and cheeks shall fade
lines.plainText: The roses in thy lips and cheeks shall fade

lines.text: To paly ashes; thy eyes' windows fall,
lines.plainText: To paly ashes thy eyes' windows fall

lines.text: Like death when he shuts up the day of life.
lines.plainText: Like death when he shuts up the day of life

lines.text: Each part depriv'd of supple government,
lines.plainText: Each part depriv'd of supple government

lines.text: Shall stiff and stark and cold appear like death.
lines.plainText: Shall stiff and stark and cold appear like death

lines.text: And in this borrow'd likeness of shrunk death
lines.plainText: And in this borrow'd likeness of shrunk death

lines.text: Thou shalt continue two and forty hours,
lines.plainText: Thou shalt continue two and forty hours

lines.text: And then awake as from a pleasant sleep.
lines.plainText: And then awake as from a pleasant sleep

lines.text: Now when the bridegroom in the morning comes
lines.plainText: Now when the bridegroom in the morning comes

lines.text: To rouse thee from thy bed, there art thou dead.
lines.plainText: To rouse thee from thy bed there art thou dead

lines.text: Then as the manner of our country is,
lines.plainText: Then as the manner of our country is

lines.text: In thy best robes, uncover'd, on the bier,
lines.plainText: In thy best robes uncover'd on the bier

lines.text: Thou shalt be borne to that same ancient vault
lines.plainText: Thou shalt be borne to that same ancient vault

lines.text: Where all the kindred of the Capulets lie.
lines.plainText: Where all the kindred of the Capulets lie

lines.text: In the meantime, against thou shalt awake,
lines.plainText: In the meantime against thou shalt awake

lines.text: Shall Romeo by my letters know our drift,
lines.plainText: Shall Romeo by my letters know our drift

lines.text: And hither shall he come, and he and I
lines.plainText: And hither shall he come and he and I

lines.text: Will watch thy waking, and that very night
lines.plainText: Will watch thy waking and that very night

lines.text: Shall Romeo bear thee hence to Mantua.
lines.plainText: Shall Romeo bear thee hence to Mantua

lines.text: And this shall free thee from this present shame,
lines.plainText: And this shall free thee from this present shame

lines.text: If no inconstant toy nor womanish fear
lines.plainText: If no inconstant toy nor womanish fear

lines.text: Abate thy valour in the acting it.
lines.plainText: Abate thy valour in the acting it

lines.text: Give me, give me! O tell not me of fear!
lines.plainText: Give me give me O tell not me of fear

lines.text: Hold; get you gone, be strong and prosperous
lines.plainText: Hold get you gone be strong and prosperous

lines.text: In this resolve. I'll send a friar with speed
lines.plainText: In this resolve I'll send a friar with speed

lines.text: To Mantua, with my letters to thy lord.
lines.plainText: To Mantua with my letters to thy lord

lines.text: Love give me strength, and strength shall help afford.
lines.plainText: Love give me strength and strength shall help afford

lines.text: Farewell, dear father.
lines.plainText: Farewell dear father
